main_text.p: contractum, עֲדָנוּ quod in הֵן positum : עַד עַתָּה Ufq; nunc, Ufq; adhuc, Genef.32. v.4. עַד מְאֹד Ufq; valde, עַד מְהֵרָה Ufq; citò, Quàm maximè, Quàm celerrimè. Admittit etiam formâ quasi numeri pluralis constructi עֲדֵי, cui etiam Affixa Pronomina junguntur; עֲדַי Ufq; ad me, עֲדֵיכֶם Ad vos, ubi irregulariter est Kametz, quasi ex formâ Quiescentium secundâ, cùm tamen Pronomen כֶּם semper forma constructa, quæ hic est עֲדֵי, adjungatur: עֲדֶיהָ Ad eam ; עֲדֶיךָ Ufq; ad te. Cum ב compositum est, Pro Propter, Per, Circa, idem quòd כְּנֶגֶד, ut probat R.Salom. Gen.7.16. בְּעַד רַעְתָם Propter malũ ipsorum, Jer.11.14. בְּעַד הָעָם הַזֶּה Pro populo isto, Ibid. בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן Per fenestram, Gen.26.8. בְּעַד מְעָרוֹת In speluncas, Pro speluncis, Jef.32.14. מִבַּעַד Inter, Intrà, Circa, Cant.4.3. Aff. וַיִּסְגֹּר יְהוָה בַּעֲדוֹ Et occlusit Dominus pro eo, Genef.7.17. Et occludes oftium בְּעָדְךָ וּבְעַד־בָּנֶיךָ Pro te & pro filiis tuis, 2.Reg.4.4. בְּעָדִי Pro vel circa me, &c. Chald. עַד Ufque ad, Esræ 7.22. עַד דִּי Ufquedum, Daniel.2.9. עַד מִנִּי Donec à me, Esr.4.21. עַד כֹּה Huc usque, Dan.7.21.

עַד ׀ עַד Æternitas, Seculum : עֲדֵי עַד Ufq; in feculum, Jefa.26.4. שֹׁכֵן עַד Inhabitans æternitatem, Jefa.57.15. מִנֵּי עַד A' feculo, Job.20.4. לְעַד In feculum, Jefa.64.9. עוֹלָם וָעֶד In feculum & æternitatem, Pfal.10.16. Kimchi in suo Michlol notat, cum Sægol semper & tantùm scribi post לְעוֹלָם vel לעולם. Semel וָעֵד Exod.15. v.18. Aben Efra ibi notat, וָעֶד לְעוֹלָם esse concisam locutionem, pro לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד עוֹלָם.
main_text.head: עָדַן
main_text.p: הִתְעַדֵּן Hithp. Oblectare se : Futur. וַיִּתְעַדְּנוּ Et oblectarunt se, Neh.9.25.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some consonants are faint in the scan; the Hebrew forms, especially the vowel points on עֲדֵי, עֲדֶיהָ, בְּעַד and the Hithpael forms, are copied as far as they are legible and may contain errors. The Latin line "Ufq;" and the Hebrew catchword are read with confidence. The page number 533 is read at the top right. No marginal notes.
